name: Tooyama Midori
source:
Midori is an energetic girl in [url=/c1355]Tatsuya[/url]'s class, good friends with both him and [url=/c1358]Natsuki[/url]. She is the clarinet leader in the concert band at her school, and senpai of [url=/c1361]Mai[/url]. Daughter of a famous musician couple.

[Edited from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yoake_Mae_yori_Ruriiro_na]Wikipedia[/url].]
